name: HTML to Markdown
summary: Convert HTML fragments to Markdown locally — headings, lists, links, code, tables, and more.
description: Paste HTML and get Markdown in your browser. Supports headings, paragraphs, bold/italic, links, images, lists, blockquotes, fenced code blocks, horizontal rules, and basic tables. Script and style tags are stripped. Not a full HTML5 engine — best for content fragments.

faqs.question: Is this a full HTML5 parser?
faqs.answer: No. It handles common content tags for everyday conversion. Complex layouts, inline styles, and exotic markup may need cleanup.

faqs.question: Are scripts kept?
faqs.answer: No. script and style elements are removed during conversion.

faqs.question: Need the reverse direction?
faqs.answer: Use Markdown to HTML to convert Markdown into HTML.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.
